23329323673723de.description: ### Job Description - Product Manager * **Role**: Product Manager * **Employment Type**: Full-Time * **Experience**: 3+ Years Experience **About Jarvis Technology & Strategy Consulting Pvt. Ltd.:** Jarvis is a political consulting firm that helps its clients solve pressing political and administrative problems using technology and data. We specialize in leveraging cutting-edge technology and advanced data sciences to create scalable solutions to complex problems. ***At Jarvis, we work across Operational Excellence, Project Management, Policy Research, Campaigns & amp; amp; Communications, and Strategy, offering a range of solutions to our clients, including governmental agencies, political parties, and some of India’s biggest and emerging unicorns.*** **About the Role:** We're looking for a **Product Manager** who can take ownership of our products from idea to launch — and everything after. You'll work with our tech, design, QA, and business teams every day, making sure everyone is on the same page and that products are built right and shipped on time. You don't need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable talking to engineers, understanding how software is built, and translating business needs into clear product requirements. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** **Plan & Document:** 1. Create and maintain detailed PRDs that clearly define product scope, features, and acceptance criteria. 2. Maintain structured documentation across all project phases, including meeting notes, decisions, and action items. 3. Prepare and distribute release notes and product updates to relevant stakeholders post-launch. **Run the Project:** 1. Facilitate regular team standups to track progress, identify risks, and remove blockers. 2. Manage tasks and sprints in a project management tool, maintaining dashboards that provide real-time visibility into project status. 3. Maintain clear and consistent communication channels across business and technical stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. **Work with Teams:** 1. Be the bridge between Engineering, QA, Design, DevOps, and Business teams — align priorities and resolve dependencies before they become problems. 2. Work with QA to make sure everything is properly tested before release. 3. Do regular product usage reviews with the Ops team to understand how the product is being used in the real world. 4. Proactively identify and address issues before they escalate. **Demos & Retrospectives:** 1. Demo the product to internal teams, business stakeholders, and external partners at key project milestones. 2. After each release, run a retrospective — separately with the project team and the business team — to capture what worked and what didn't. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:** **Experience & amp; Skills:** * 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role. * Strong written and verbal communication — you can explain complex things simply. * Experience writing PRDs, managing project documentation, and running standups. * Hands-on experience with JIRA for task management, sprint planning, and dashboards. **Technical Knowledge:** * Comfortable working with engineering teams — you understand the basics of how software is built, including development cycles, sprints, and releases. * Familiar with APIs and how systems talk to each other (you don't need to write code, but you should understand the concepts). * Able to read and interpret basic technical documents, architecture diagrams, or data flows well enough to ask the right questions. * Understanding of QA processes — what testing phases look like and what goes into a release checklist. * Comfortable with tools like JIRA, Confluence, or similar platforms for documentation and project tracking. **Mindset:** * Detail-oriented — things don't slip through the cracks with you. * Proactive — you spot problems early and act on them without being asked. * A team player who can work across very different kinds of people — developers, designers, and business leads alike.

Own a core part of the LAP product end-to-end - from problem, to roadmap, to a shipped and measured outcome. LAP (Loan Against Property) is a secured-lending product - larger loans, longer timelines, and real operational, credit, and regulatory complexity. As PM, you'll own a slice of it - the customer journey from application to disbursal, onboarding and verification, or a brand-new feature - and be accountable for its outcome. You'll set the roadmap, write the specs, drive engineering, manage the partners in the flow, and bring leadership clear recommendations.

Key Responsibilities: 
• The roadmap and outcomes for your area — turning business goals into a prioritized, defensible plan.
• Clear product specs and user stories; breaking ambiguous problems into shippable pieces.
• Your own data. Pull and interrogate it yourself (SQL, product analytics tools) to find where customers drop off, size opportunities, and prove impact — without waiting on an analyst.
• Flows that survive the real world — designed hand-in-hand with Credit, Sales, Operations, and Compliance.
• The external partners and vendors that sit inside the lending flow — evaluating, negotiating, and managing them (e.g. credit bureau, KYC/video-verification, digital signing, auto-debit mandates, banking and valuation partners).
• The voice of the borrower — including the cases where agents or channel partners sit between us and the customer.
• Direct working relationships with senior leadership, bringing them structured, decision-ready thinking.

What we're looking for (must-haves)
• 1.5–2 years in lending product, within a broader product/analytics background. Secured-lending experience is a strong plus.
• Tech-first. You read technical/API documentation on your own, challenge engineering on how things are built, and reason about trade-offs - not just the screens.
• Data-fluent. You can write or read SQL and build a drop-off funnel yourself.
• Regulatory instinct. You understand how lending regulations (KYC norms, video verification, loan-pricing and fee disclosures, fair lending practices) shape what you can ship — and you design with those guardrails in mind.
• Strong written structuring. You turn a messy problem into a clear one-pager.
• High ownership, street-smart, a genuine go-getter. Comfortable in ambiguity, biased to ship, and you close loops without being chased.
• Influence without authority across Sales, Credit, and Operations.

About Kissht:
Kissht is a Great Place to Work® certified consumer-first credit app transforming the landscape of
consumer lending through data and machine-based decisioning. Serving over 15 million customers, including a significant share from Tier-2 cities and beyond, Kissht offers short-term and long-term loans for personal, business, and recurring needs.

Founded by IIT and IIM alumni and backed by leading investors such as Endiya Partners, Brunei Investment Authority, and the Singapore Government, Kissht is among India’s fastest growing fintech companies. Join us to be part of a dynamic and innovative organization shaping the future of financial technology.
